metadata.title: Design and Clone a gRNA for a CRISPR Experiment
metadata.purpose: Plan a CRISPR manipulation, select and assess gRNA candidates, and prepare a vector-specific cloning plan using Addgene guidance.
metadata.scope: This is a design-level protocol. The Addgene guide identifies vector-specific cloning instructions as required for the actual oligo insertion procedure.

materials.name: Selected Cas enzyme or expression system

tables.title: Design choices summarized from Addgene guidance
rows: Target a constitutively expressed region, a 5′ exon, or an essential protein domain.
Select a cut site as close as possible to the desired edit; the guide states ideally less than 10 bp away.
Target the transcription start site region.

steps.action: Define the desired genetic manipulation and select an appropriate Cas system using table t1.
Select the genetic element to target according to the intended manipulation.
steps.criticalNotes: For HDR, the guide recommends a cut site as close as possible to the intended edit, ideally less than 10 bp away.

steps.action: Use gRNA design software to identify candidate guides and assess predicted on-target and off-target activity.
steps.criticalNotes: The guide advises checking the genomic target sequence in the sample to identify mismatches from the reference sequence.

steps.action: Select a gRNA expression vector and obtain the protocol associated with that specific vector.
For vectors that support it, synthesize, anneal, and insert targeting oligos by standard restriction-ligation cloning using the vector-specific protocol.
steps.criticalNotes: The linked guide states that the exact cloning strategy depends on the selected gRNA vector; no volumes, enzymes, temperatures, or times are supplied here.

steps.action: Choose the Cas/gRNA expression and delivery system for the target cell type, deliver the components, and validate the intended edit.

limitations: This link-derived record does not supply a vector-specific cloning recipe or experimental parameters; it preserves the source's requirement to consult the selected vector's protocol.

sources.title: How to Design Your gRNA for CRISPR Genome Editing
